title: Visualized ores
body:
You have been mining and you found a ore, but you didn't know what is it?                                                 

## Not anymore. Visualized ores is perfect mod for you and escpecially colorblind people

**Every ore will now have vizualized drop of what will drop from it as shown below**
  
  
  
 
![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/18016765989e222d19633d9138f302620c8ba92f.png)

Resource pack doesn't need any more things to function, just download it and put it in the resource pack folder
